name: Sony C
biography:
I am HotwifeSonyC, a Brazilian hotwife living in Las Vegas. My husband gave me a permanent hall pass. I get into trouble all week long.

This is my video diary. I go on solo dates, have adventures with other swingers, and film the stories my friends would make me tell twice. Some nights go exactly as planned. My favorite stories usually start when the plan goes out the window. If you see it here, it really happened.

I have a soft spot for cubs, and yes, I like BBC, BWC, and the everyday guy who makes me laugh and has me checking my phone on the way home. I love variety. Half the fun is being surprised by who catches my eye.

In Vegas, a quiet Tuesday can turn into a solo date that has my husband asking what happened next.

Ever wonder what a married woman actually does with a permanent hall pass? Pick the video with the title you would have a hard time explaining, and start there.
